title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs Clause: Remaining Card Term at a Manufacturer Copay Card Period Opening
content:
**Clause.** When a Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs opens a new benefit period, the whole months from today to the program's expiration date set the term rule applied to the annual maximum: **fewer than 6 months** credit half of the annual maximum, **6 to 11 months** credit the annual maximum times those whole months over 12, rounded to the cent half up, and **12 months or more** credit the annual maximum whole.

The expiration date is the one the card enrollment shows; complete months only are counted.

| Whole months from today to the expiration date | Part of the annual maximum credited |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | half |
| 6 to 11 | whole months over 12, rounded half up |
| 12 or more | the whole |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical annual maximum of $9600.00).**

| Whole months left | Credit under the term rule |
|---|---|
| 5 | $4800.00 |
| 6 | $4800.00 |
| 7 | $5600.00 |
| 11 | $8800.00 |
| 12 | $9600.00 |
